main_text.p: 1.de vocat.Gent. cap.24.ad probandū; »In fide & operibus bonis proficere, ac perseverare usque ad finem, muneris atque auxilii esse divini. Dixi autem, plerisque; contra exceptionem Pontificiam, de particulari revelatione. Plerique enim loquuntur de omnibus fidelibus: ut Rom. 8. v. 33. »&c. Quid est, quòd jubemur nosmet-ipsos tentare, an simus in fide? 2 Cor. 13. v. 5. &, ex »Christo in nobis habitare, cernere vocationem »nostram; 1 Cor. 1. v. 26. indicem prædestina-tionis nostræ? Rom. 8. v. 30. Act. 13. v. 48. Ipse »Spiritus contestatur spiritui nostro, quòd simus »filii Dei. Si autem filii: & hæredes. &c. Ut allegat ipse, Epistolâ ad Demetriadem.

Neque tamen vel Augustinum, vel Pro-sperum, forte à nobis hoc unico capite dissentientes, accusaremus Pelagianismi: tum, quia in eo dissensus apertus nullus fuit olim: tum, quia, si fuisset; illi admoniti, mordicus non defendissent hanc sententiam. page.notes: Doubtful: the abbreviation mark over "probandū" is read as a macron on the u. The page number "88" is read from a small, faint print at the top. The » marks at the start of lines are printed quotation markers, kept inline. The catchword "reses" is the first word of the next page, set alone below the last line. Possible printing issue: "ad probandū;" appears to run into the quotation with no capital, as printed.
